events.title: Woodstock Festival anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Festival of Music & Art took place in Bethel, New York, in August 1969.

angles.name: Woodstock Remembered
angles.copy: Remembering the legendary Woodstock Festival, a pivotal moment in music history that defined a generation back in '69. What was your favourite performance?

events.title: Elvis Presley tribute
events.blurb: On this day, we remember the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who passed away in 1977.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: Remembering the King today. Elvis Presley's legacy continues to inspire generations, decades after his passing. What's your go-to Elvis track?

events.title: Tupac Shakur tribute
events.blurb: We remember the influential rapper Tupac Shakur, who tragically died in 1996.

angles.name: Tupac Remembered
angles.copy: Remembering Tupac Shakur, a lyrical genius whose impact on music and culture is still felt today, 30 years after his passing. What's your favourite Tupac track?

events.title: Jimi Hendrix tribute
events.blurb: We remember the legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix, who passed away in 1970.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Remembered
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled talent of Jimi Hendrix, whose guitar wizardry changed music forever. Which Hendrix track still gives you chills?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Anniversary
angles.copy: On this day in '69, The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That iconic album cover and those timeless tracks – what's your top pick from the record?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie Hynde
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the iconic Chrissie Hynde! The Pretenders frontwoman still rocks harder than most. What's your favourite Pretenders tune?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam Gallagher
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing the rock 'n' roll attitude. What's your favourite Oasis anthem?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic single "Imagine" was released in the UK on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine Anniversary
angles.copy: On this day in '75, John Lennon released his timeless anthem 'Imagine'. A song that still resonates today. What does it mean to you?

events.title: First iPod released
events.blurb: Apple launched the very first iPod, revolutionising how we listen to music, on this day in 2001.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember when the first iPod dropped in '01? Suddenly, thousands of songs in your pocket was a reality. What was the first album you loaded onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Day
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From Sean Connery to Daniel Craig, who's your favourite 007 and what's the ultimate Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: We remember the legendary John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: Thinking of John Lennon today, who would have been 86. His music and message continue to inspire generations. What's your favourite Lennon or Beatles track?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the comedy legend John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, what's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: On this day in '68, The Beatles dropped 'The White Album'. A sprawling masterpiece with so many classics. Which track is your absolute favourite?

events.title: Freddie Mercury tribute
events.blurb: We remember the incomparable Freddie Mercury, lead singer of Queen, who passed away in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Remembered
angles.copy: Remembering the legendary Freddie Mercury, whose voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your ultimate Queen anthem?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: On this day in '65, The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul'. A pivotal album that showed their incredible evolution. What's your favourite track from it?
